what: Add `blaze-item-hash = { path = "crates/blaze-item-hash" }` to [workspace.dependencies] in the root Cargo.toml (next to blaze-items), and the crate to Cargo.lock at the next build. New crate of lane item-hash (docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md): body identities for the item store; blaze-cargo depends on it to install `hir_ty::body_store`.

history.note: root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]: blaze-item-hash = { path = "crates/blaze-item-hash" } after blaze-items. Cargo.lock already has its entry (members are crates/*) with every dependency of its Cargo.toml; blaze-cargo gains it in the lock when it depends on it, at the next refresh.
